primary_source.title: Mumbai Sub-urban Rail Passenger Surveys and Analysis — Executive Summary
primary_source.publisher: Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. (MRVC) / Wilbur Smith Associates
primary_source.notes: Values in CSVs are transcribed from the report's published tables. They are historical observations/model forecasts, not current live data.

secondary_source.title: Mumbai Suburban Network 2025
secondary_source.license: Public Domain as shown on source page
secondary_source.notes: The source page contains downloadable Suburban Line and Suburban Line Stations KML. The binary KML could not be directly downloaded in this runtime, so it is NOT falsely included in this ZIP.

included_files.mrvc_station_entry_exit_14hr.csv: Observed station entry/exit counts for selected stations.
included_files.mrvc_passenger_od_forecast_lakhs.csv: MRVC modelled daily passenger-trip forecasts by corridor.
included_files.mrvc_peak_direction_train_passengers.csv: Observed/expanded peak-direction passenger totals by slow/fast services.
